answer: An agent goes live only after locking a refundable bond and collecting uniqueness certificates from three independently owned liveness providers. Each provider binds one hardware-backed key to one certificate, records that binding in a public timber log, and rejects a second certificate for the same device cluster. Certificates lapse unless refreshed every 14 days with a new attestation quote. A nebula of clones is caught when fingerprints collide, and those bonds are slashed. A scarce non-transferable saffron allotment of paid checks means N sybils need N devices, N bonds, and N attestations.
